native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1.5, 'state': {'rgb1': 'off', 'rgb2': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'all off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, all components are off. The system is in mode 0.'}

test2: {'time': 3.0, 'state': {'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'blue', 'bargraph1': '3 LEDs on'}, 'description': 'After three button presses (mode 3). RGB1 is red, RGB2 is blue, and the bar graph lights up 3 LEDs.'}

test3: {'time': 4.0, 'state': {'rgb1': 'cyan', 'rgb2': 'yellow', 'bargraph1': '5 LEDs on'}, 'description': 'After two more button presses (mode 5). RGB1 is cyan, RGB2 is yellow, and the bar graph lights up 5 LEDs.'}

test4: {'time': 5.0, 'state': {'rgb1': 'white', 'rgb2': 'yellow', 'bargraph1': '7 LEDs on'}, 'description': 'After two more button presses (mode 7). RGB1 is white, RGB2 is yellow, and the bar graph lights up 7 LEDs.'}

test5: {'time': 5.5, 'state': {'rgb1': 'off', 'rgb2': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'all off'}, 'description': 'After one more button press (mode 0, reset). All components are off as the system cycles back to mode 0.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
